description: This is a shell script that provides a command-line interface for managing OCI containers via HTTP JSON-RPC calls. It includes functions to start, stop, list, get info, pause, resume, and execute commands within containers, utilizing curl to send requests to a local service.

methods.name: start_container_from_bundle
methods.description: Starts an OCI container from a specified bundle directory or tarball.

methods.name: start_container_from_spec
methods.description: Starts an OCI container from a Dobby JSON spec file.

methods.name: stop_container
methods.description: Stops a running container by container ID.

methods.name: get_container_info
methods.description: Fetches information about a specific container.

methods.name: get_container_state
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of a specific container.

methods.name: execute_command
methods.description: Executes a command inside a specified container.

methods.name: ocicontainer_help
methods.description: Prints help information about available commands.
